title: CANDOR: A Multilingual Provenance-Documented Corpus for Dysarthric Speech Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.28930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CANDOR assembles 61 corpora across 17 languages and five aetiological classes plus a mixed/other group. Its register counts 2,057 speakers classified as dysarthric and 19,538 healthy controls. The collection contains 4,469.7 hours of audio, including 1,178.8 hours in the dysarthric subset. Counts use speech-impairment labels where available and diagnosis labels otherwise. The collection includes 732 dysarthric speakers across 14 non-English languages; 194 speakers use six languages unsupported by Qwen3-ASR, the model underlying its non-English baselines. We document composition, chain of custody, licences and transfer terms, while distinguishing corpus-level provenance from participant-level consent records, which we hold for few constituents. Among 31 dysarthric-bearing corpora, open licences cover 29.0% of corpora, 10.5% of speakers and 8.2% of hours. Excluding the English Speech Accessibility Project raises the open hour share to 31.2

translated_title: CANDOR：一个用于构音障碍语音研究的多语言来源记录语料库
translated_abstract: CANDOR 汇集了涵盖 17 种语言、五个病因学类别以及一个混合/其他类别的 61 个语料库。其登记册包含 2,057 名被归类为构音障碍的说话者和 19,538 名健康对照者。该合集包含 4,469.7 小时的音频，其中构音障碍子集占 1,178.8 小时。统计计数在可用时使用言语障碍标签，否则使用诊断标签。该合集包含跨越 14 种非英语语言的 732 名构音障碍说话者；其中 194 名说话者使用的六种语言不受 Qwen3-ASR（其非英语基线所基于的模型）支持。我们记录了语料构成、保管链、许可证和转让条款，同时区分语料库层面的来源记录与参与者层面的知情同意记录（我们仅持有少数组成部分的知情同意记录）。在 31 个包含构音障碍数据的语料库中，开放许可证覆盖了 29.0% 的语料库、10.5% 的说话者和 8.2% 的音频时长。排除英语的 Speech Accessibility Project 后，开放时长占比提升至 31.2%。
tldr: CANDOR 构建了一个涵盖 17 种语言、包含 2,057 名构音障碍说话者及超过 4,400 小时音频的大规模多语言构音障碍语音语料库，并系统记录了数据来源、保管链、许可证与知情同意等治理信息，为构音障碍语音研究提供了前所未有的公开资源基础。
en_tdlr: CANDOR is a large-scale multilingual dysarthric speech corpus spanning 17 languages with over 2,000 dysarthric speakers and 4,400+ hours of audio, distinguished by its systematic documentation of provenance, chain of custody, licensing, and consent records to support responsible dysarthric speech research.
